stories.story: As a visitor to the Connect design-system showcase page, I see a footer identifying the page, so that I know what design system and page I am looking at.
acceptanceCriteria: apps/connect/index.html has one new <footer> element after the last existing section, containing exactly one line of text identifying the page as the focx design-system showcase.
The footer has a top border using var(--border-hairline) as the width and var(--border-subtle) as the color, and no other decoration (no background, box-shadow, or border-radius).
The footer's text is styled with font-size: var(--text-caption) and font-weight: var(--weight-regular), and no other font-size or font-weight rule applies to it.

The footer's spacing (its margin above the rule and padding between the rule and the text) uses only token values already defined in apps/connect/styles.css's :root block (e.g. var(--space-3), var(--control-px-lg)) — no new pixel literals anywhere in the diff.
node tools/drift-check/index.mjs exits 0 against the changed files.
No markup, class, or style outside the new footer changes in apps/connect/index.html or apps/connect/styles.css versus the pre-run committed version.

outOfScope: Restyling, reorganizing, or otherwise modifying the eyebrow, heading, Button/Primary, Button/Destructive, or Confirmation actions sections.
Adding new tokens to design/tokens/focx or design/tokens/connect for this footer.
Footer navigation, links, icons, or multi-line content — a single caption line only.
Running or wiring tools/poc-builder into this change.
designSystemNeeds: focx.style.ui-caption (UI/Caption text style, via its text-caption and weight-regular sub-tokens)
